meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view. Cards run oldest-to-newest, Enter splits after the source card, Backspace at the start of a card merges it into the previous one, and an empty card is deleted immediately (Backspace in it also removes it). An empty title is just a blank click target until clicked. Click an index to select, drag to reorder, merge a selection, move between cards with the arrow keys, and improve only the selected cards with AI — the button turns into undo and identical content reuses the previous answer. Insert, send and archive+delete groups wait briefly before expanding on hover; insert/send include current-session and new-session actions, while replace and archive stay single-click primaries. Image chips open an in-panel preview; non-empty delete asks for confirmation and warns the action cannot be undone. The footer shows one shortcut tip at a time and rotates on click; copy-all skips archived segments; sending follows the General Settings busy-send policy. Pending counts appear on the hidden launcher and the sidebar workspace row, auto refresh keeps the list scroll position, the textarea only shows a scrollbar at its height limit, Ctrl+Shift+R (or the header reset button) resets the panel geometry, and the panel never covers the host title bar.
